Government to Address Soaring Home Heating Oil Costs

The Irish Taoiseach has stated that the government will address the soaring cost of home-heating oil in the upcoming Budget. This measure aims to tackle the rising prices that are impacting households. The situation in the Northwest Territories (N.W.T.) in Canada was also highlighted, where rising home heating costs could lead to 'dire' circumstances.
